title: UDX catalog dump
description: Expected UDX dump format for catalog/udx/components.json. One row per component: selector, inputs/variants, optional tokens. A matching CSV is equivalent. Magic Patterns does not produce this file. Populate from @udx/lib or https://udx.dev.bny.net/llms.txt — never invent rows. The committed stub may have an empty components array (membership checks disabled until populated). A partial dump is enough to verify inventory.angularTarget for mapped rows (Gate A). Unmapped rows stay todo.

name.description: Human/catalog name. Optional aid for matching Magic Patterns react.name.

react.description: Magic Patterns / React component name this selector maps from (e.g. Button).

inputs.description: Allowed input names → allowed values (variants). Object form: { "variant": ["primary", "secondary"], "size": ["sm", "md"] }. A CSV dump may flatten this to inputs + variants columns.

variants.description: Optional alias when inputs are listed as names only; variant values live here.
